messages:
jules: quick sketch: add a tiny `lease` block in rollout metadata so clients can request tenant-scoped affinity without global pins. scope + type + lease{id,expires,audit_ref}. thoughts?

mina: good idea. add a `probe` mode so clients can test routing without creating leases. probe should return `probe_confidence` and `probe_ttl_ms`.

corey: ops: we need GC and reconcile states: `active|revoked|expired|orphaned`. runtime should reconcile periodically and expose `stale_leases_reclaimed` metric.

mina: name bikeshed: call the field `lease` not `handshake`. also include `grace_window_ms` so clients know eviction timing. for hard pins require `commit_level` (`reserved|best-effort`).

jules: compatibility plan: add `X-Lease-Supported` header on resolve. clients can probe then opt-in. emit telemetry when lease fields ignored.

corey: index storage: keep routing index small (bitmask + lease_ptr), full lease lives in secondary table. add per-tenant `max_lease_ms` cap.

mina: client flow idea: 1) resolve with `client_probe=true` 2) examine `lease_supported` + `probe_confidence` 3) request lease if ok -> control-plane issues `lease_id` -> runtime honors affinity.

ops-bot: queued: lease-metadata-rfc -> staging (sha: c0ffee) :rocket:
